17.source_text: but in her temporal welfare she was not equally prosperous. She was destitute of bread and had nothing to sustain life. The minister kindly told her to exercise faith and she could make stones into bread. She thanked him for his timely advice, she had never thought of that, and accordingly went and procured some stones of suitable size for loaves of bread,

18.source_text: robe, and kept all in order, never allowing a string or a button to be off, but kept all in good repair.
